title: Real-Life: Rental car return
situation: You rented a car and need to return it. Your flight leaves at 6 a.m. tomorrow, and the gas tank is half full. You hear the following explanation from the rental company.
script: Narrator: Thank you for choosing Coastline Car Rental. When returning your car, please bring it to the rental lot at the airport. Our counter is open from seven a.m. to ten p.m. If you need to return the car outside these hours, park it in the area marked "After-Hours Return" and put the key in the drop box. Please remember to fill the tank before returning the car. If the tank is not full, we will charge a refueling fee of fifteen dollars plus the cost of the gas, which is much higher than at regular gas stations. There's a gas station just before the airport entrance.
translation: コーストライン・レンタカーをご利用いただきありがとうございます。車を返却する際は、空港のレンタカー駐車場へお持ちください。カウンターは午前7時から午後10時まで開いています。この時間外に返却する必要がある場合は、「時間外返却」と表示された場所に駐車し、鍵を返却ボックスに入れてください。返却前に必ずガソリンを満タンにしてください。満タンでない場合、給油手数料15ドルとガソリン代を請求します。ガソリン代は通常のガソリンスタンドよりかなり高くなります。空港の入口のすぐ手前にガソリンスタンドがあります。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Return the car at the counter at seven a.m.
Return the car without refueling.
Fill the tank and use the after-hours return area.
Leave the key at the counter tonight at eleven.
questions.explanation: 6時発の便ではカウンターが開く7時を待てない。ガソリンを満タンにして時間外返却エリアに停め、鍵を返却ボックスに入れる。

title: Real-Life: University course registration
situation: You are a university student. You want to take Professor Kim's economics course, but the online registration shows that it is full. You hear the following message from the student office.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling the student office. If a course you want is full, you can add your name to the waiting list online. Students on the waiting list will be contacted if a place becomes available. However, for courses taught by Professor Kim, the waiting list is not used. Instead, students must attend the first class and ask the professor directly for permission to join. The first class for all economics courses will be held next Monday. Please note that the registration period ends next Friday.
translation: 学生課にお電話いただきありがとうございます。希望の授業が満員の場合は、オンラインでキャンセル待ちリストに名前を登録できます。リストに載った学生には、空きが出た場合に連絡します。ただし、キム教授の授業ではキャンセル待ちリストは使われません。代わりに、学生は最初の授業に出席し、教授に直接参加の許可を求めなければなりません。経済学の授業はすべて、来週月曜日に初回が行われます。なお、登録期間は来週金曜日に終了します。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Add your name to the waiting list online.
Go to the first class and ask the professor.
Call the student office again next Friday.
Register for another economics course.
questions.explanation: キム教授の授業はキャンセル待ちリストを使わないので、初回の授業に出て教授に直接許可を求める。

title: Real-Life: Moving trash
situation: You are moving out of your apartment this weekend. You have an old sofa and a broken microwave oven to throw away. You call the city office and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling the city waste management office. Large furniture items, such as sofas and beds, are collected only by reservation. Please book a pickup online or by phone at least one week in advance and buy a collection sticker at a convenience store. Small electronic items, such as microwaves, toasters, and hair dryers, cannot be collected by the city. Please take them to the electronics recycling box at City Hall or to any participating electronics store. Large furniture can also be brought directly to the city recycling center on weekends without a reservation, but a fee is charged by weight.
translation: 市の廃棄物管理課にお電話いただきありがとうございます。ソファやベッドなどの大型家具は、予約制でのみ回収します。少なくとも1週間前までにオンラインまたは電話で回収を予約し、コンビニエンスストアで回収シールをお買い求めください。電子レンジ、トースター、ドライヤーなどの小型電子機器は、市では回収できません。市役所の電子機器リサイクルボックス、または協力している電器店にお持ちください。大型家具は、週末であれば予約なしで市のリサイクルセンターに直接持ち込むこともできますが、重さに応じて料金がかかります。

questions.question: What should you do with the sofa?
choices: Take it to the recycling center this weekend.
Book a pickup for next week.
Put it out with the regular trash.
Take it to an electronics store.
questions.explanation: 今週末に引っ越すので1週間前予約の回収には間に合わない。週末なら予約なしでリサイクルセンターに持ち込める。

title: Real-Life: Passport renewal
situation: Your passport expires in two months. You are going abroad on business in three weeks. You hear the following information at the passport office.
script: Narrator: To renew your passport, please submit the application form, your current passport, and one photo taken within the last six months. Standard processing takes about four weeks. If you need your passport sooner, you can apply for express processing, which takes five business days and costs an additional sixty dollars. To apply for express processing, you must show proof of travel, such as a flight booking. Please also note that many countries require your passport to be valid for at least six months from the date you enter the country.
translation: パスポートを更新するには、申請書、現在のパスポート、6か月以内に撮影した写真1枚を提出してください。通常の手続きには約4週間かかります。もっと早く必要な場合は特急手続きを申請でき、5営業日で、追加料金60ドルがかかります。特急手続きを申請するには、航空券の予約など渡航の証明を提示する必要があります。また、多くの国では入国日から少なくとも6か月間パスポートが有効であることが求められますのでご注意ください。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply for standard processing.
Travel with your current passport.
Apply for express processing with proof of your flight.
Wait until after your trip to renew.
questions.explanation: 出発は3週間後で通常手続き(4週間)では間に合わず、残り2か月のパスポートでは入国できない国が多い。航空券の予約を示して特急手続きを申請する。

title: Real-Life: Cooking class
situation: You want to join a cooking class to learn how to make Italian food. You are a vegetarian. You hear the following information from a cooking school.
script: Narrator: Here are our cooking classes for next month. On Monday evenings, we offer Italian Basics, where you'll learn to make fresh pasta with meat sauce. On Wednesday evenings, our Mediterranean Vegetables class covers dishes from Italy, Greece, and Spain, all made without meat or fish. On Saturdays, we have Japanese Home Cooking, which includes several vegetarian options. Each class costs forty dollars. If you have any food allergies or dietary restrictions, please let us know when you register, and our chefs will try to provide alternatives where possible.
translation: 来月の料理教室をご案内します。月曜の夜は「イタリアンの基本」で、生パスタとミートソースの作り方を学びます。水曜の夜の「地中海の野菜料理」では、イタリア、ギリシャ、スペインの料理を、すべて肉や魚を使わずに作ります。土曜日は「日本の家庭料理」で、ベジタリアン向けの料理もいくつかあります。各クラス40ドルです。食物アレルギーや食事制限がある場合は、登録時にお知らせください。シェフができる限り代わりの料理をご用意します。

questions.question: Which class should you take?
choices: The Monday class.
The Saturday class.
The Wednesday class.
Both the Monday and Wednesday classes.
questions.explanation: 水曜の地中海の野菜料理はイタリア料理を含み、肉や魚を使わないのでベジタリアンに最適。月曜はミートソース、土曜は日本料理。

title: Real-Life: Job application
situation: You want to apply for a sales position at a company. You have three years of sales experience but no university degree. You hear the following message from the company's human resources department.
script: Narrator: Thank you for your interest in working with us. We're currently hiring for two positions in sales. The Sales Manager position requires a university degree and at least five years of sales experience. The Sales Representative position requires at least two years of experience in sales or customer service, but no degree is required. Applications for both positions must be submitted through our website by the end of this month. Please include your résumé and a cover letter. Applicants who pass the first stage will be invited to an interview in early next month.
translation: 当社での就職にご関心をお寄せいただきありがとうございます。現在、営業職を2つ募集しています。営業マネージャー職には大学の学位と5年以上の営業経験が必要です。営業担当者職には営業または顧客対応の経験が2年以上必要ですが、学位は不要です。どちらの職への応募も、今月末までに当社ウェブサイトから提出してください。履歴書とカバーレターを添付してください。一次選考を通過した方は、来月上旬に面接にお招きします。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Apply online for the Sales Manager position.
Apply online for the Sales Representative position.
Get a university degree first.
Wait until next month to apply.
questions.explanation: 営業経験3年で学位なしなので、学位不要で経験2年以上の営業担当者職に応募できる。マネージャー職は学位と5年の経験が必要。

title: Real-Life: Ferry schedule
situation: You are on an island and need to catch a train on the mainland that leaves at 4:30 p.m. The train station is a 20-minute walk from the ferry terminal on the mainland. It is now 2:00 p.m. You hear the following announcement.
script: Narrator: Attention, passengers. Due to strong winds, the 2:30 ferry to the mainland has been canceled. The next ferry will depart at 3:30 and arrive at 4:15. A high-speed boat is also available at 2:45, arriving at the mainland at 3:15, but it requires an additional fare of twenty dollars. Please note that the high-speed boat arrives at the north pier, which is about ten minutes by bus from the main ferry terminal. Buses from the north pier run every fifteen minutes and stop in front of the train station.
translation: 乗客の皆様にお知らせします。強風のため、2時30分発の本土行きフェリーは欠航となりました。次のフェリーは3時30分に出発し、4時15分に到着します。2時45分発の高速船もご利用いただけ、本土には3時15分に到着しますが、追加料金20ドルがかかります。なお、高速船は北桟橋に到着します。北桟橋はメインのフェリーターミナルからバスで約10分です。北桟橋からのバスは15分ごとに運行し、駅前に停車します。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Take the 3:30 ferry.
Wait for the winds to calm down.
Take the high-speed boat and walk to the station.
Take the high-speed boat and then a bus.
questions.explanation: 3時30分のフェリーは4時15分着で、駅まで徒歩20分では4時30分に間に合わない。高速船で3時15分に着き、駅前に停まるバスに乗れば間に合う。北桟橋から歩くと遠い。

title: Real-Life: Internet problem
situation: Your home internet has stopped working. The lights on your router are blinking red. You call the internet provider and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling Netlink Customer Support. We are currently experiencing a service outage in the Eastwood and Riverside areas. Our engineers are working on the problem, and service is expected to return by six p.m. If you live in another area, please first try turning your router off and on again. If the lights on your router are green but you still can't connect, please check your computer's settings. If the lights are blinking red, there may be a problem with the cable connection. In that case, please press two to book a visit from a technician.
translation: ネットリンクのカスタマーサポートにお電話いただきありがとうございます。現在、イーストウッドとリバーサイドの地域で通信障害が発生しています。技術者が対応中で、午後6時までに復旧する見込みです。ほかの地域にお住まいの方は、まずルーターの電源を入れ直してください。ルーターのランプが緑なのに接続できない場合は、パソコンの設定をご確認ください。ランプが赤く点滅している場合は、ケーブルの接続に問題がある可能性があります。その場合は、2を押して技術者の訪問をご予約ください。

questions.question: You live in the Northfield area. What should you do?
choices: Wait until six p.m. for service to return.
Restart your router and then book a technician if needed.
Check your computer's settings.
Call back after the outage ends.
questions.explanation: 障害地域ではないので、まずルーターを再起動する。ランプが赤く点滅したままならケーブルの問題なので技術者を予約する。

title: Real-Life: Charity run
situation: You want to take part in a charity run with your 10-year-old daughter. Neither of you has run long distances before. You hear the following information.
script: Narrator: The annual City Charity Run will be held on May twelfth. There are three courses this year. The ten-kilometer course is for experienced runners aged sixteen and over. The five-kilometer course is open to anyone aged twelve and over. For families with younger children, we have a three-kilometer fun run, which can be walked or run, and children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult. The registration fee is twenty dollars for adults and ten dollars for children, and all money goes to the children's hospital. Registration closes on April thirtieth.
translation: 毎年恒例の市民チャリティーランが5月12日に開催されます。今年は3つのコースがあります。10キロコースは16歳以上の経験豊富なランナー向けです。5キロコースは12歳以上なら誰でも参加できます。小さな子どものいる家族向けには3キロのファンランがあり、歩いても走ってもかまいません。12歳未満の子どもは大人の同伴が必要です。参加費は大人20ドル、子ども10ドルで、すべて子ども病院に寄付されます。申し込みは4月30日に締め切ります。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Register together for the five-kilometer course.
Register your daughter alone for the fun run.
Register for the ten-kilometer course.
Register together for the three-kilometer fun run.
questions.explanation: 10歳の娘は5キロコース(12歳以上)に出られない。3キロのファンランなら大人同伴で一緒に参加できる。

title: Real-Life: Bank card
situation: You lost your bank card yesterday. You think you dropped it on the street. You call your bank and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Thank you for calling First City Bank. If your card has been lost or stolen, please press one immediately to stop the card. This service is available twenty-four hours a day. After the card has been stopped, you can order a new card online, and it will arrive by mail within seven days. If you need a card urgently, you can visit any of our branches with photo identification, and a temporary card will be issued on the spot. If you notice any unusual transactions on your account, please report them to our fraud department.
translation: ファースト・シティ銀行にお電話いただきありがとうございます。カードを紛失または盗難された場合は、すぐに1を押してカードを停止してください。このサービスは24時間ご利用いただけます。カードの停止後、オンラインで新しいカードを注文でき、7日以内に郵送で届きます。急ぎでカードが必要な場合は、写真付きの身分証明書を持ってどの支店にお越しいただいても、その場で仮カードを発行します。口座に不審な取引があれば、不正対策部門にご報告ください。

questions.question: What should you do first?
choices: Order a new card online.
Visit a branch for a temporary card.
Report to the fraud department.
Press one to stop the card.
questions.explanation: まず1を押してカードを停止する。新カードの注文や仮カードの発行は停止の後。

title: Real-Life: Hiking trail
situation: You are planning a hike with your friends tomorrow. You want a trail that takes less than four hours and has a view of the lake. You hear the following information at a visitor center.
script: Narrator: Here's some information about our hiking trails. The Summit Trail takes about six hours and offers the best views of the lake and surrounding mountains. The Forest Trail is an easy two-hour walk through the woods, but there is no view of the lake. The Ridge Trail takes about three hours and has several viewpoints overlooking the lake. However, part of the Ridge Trail is currently closed because of a landslide, so hikers must use the detour, which adds about one and a half hours. The Waterfall Trail takes three and a half hours and passes the lake shore at the halfway point.
translation: ハイキングコースについてご案内します。サミット・トレイルは約6時間で、湖と周りの山々の最高の景色が見られます。フォレスト・トレイルは森の中を歩く2時間の易しいコースですが、湖は見えません。リッジ・トレイルは約3時間で、湖を見渡す展望地点がいくつかあります。ただし、リッジ・トレイルの一部は土砂崩れのため現在閉鎖中で、迂回路を使う必要があり、約1時間半長くなります。ウォーターフォール・トレイルは3時間半で、中間地点で湖畔を通ります。

questions.question: Which trail should you take?
choices: The Waterfall Trail.
The Ridge Trail.
The Forest Trail.
The Summit Trail.
questions.explanation: リッジ・トレイルは迂回で約4時間半になる。4時間未満で湖が見えるのは3時間半で湖畔を通るウォーターフォール・トレイル。

title: Real-Life: Office printer
situation: You need to print 200 color copies of a brochure by noon today. It is now 9 a.m. You call the office services department and hear the following message.
script: Narrator: Hello, this is Office Services. For printing jobs of under fifty pages, please use the printers on your own floor. For larger jobs, please submit your file through the company print portal. Black-and-white jobs are usually completed within two hours. Color jobs take at least one business day because they are sent to an outside printing company. If you need color printing urgently, please contact Mark in the design department, who can approve the use of the high-speed color printer on the fifth floor for urgent jobs.
translation: こちらはオフィスサービス課です。50ページ未満の印刷は、各フロアのプリンターをご利用ください。それより多い印刷は、社内の印刷ポータルからファイルを提出してください。白黒印刷は通常2時間以内に仕上がります。カラー印刷は外部の印刷会社に送るため、少なくとも1営業日かかります。急ぎでカラー印刷が必要な場合は、デザイン部のマークに連絡してください。急ぎの仕事には、5階の高速カラープリンターの使用を承認してもらえます。

questions.question: What should you do?
choices: Contact Mark in the design department.
Submit your file through the print portal.
Use the printer on your own floor.
Print the brochure in black and white.
questions.explanation: 大量のカラー印刷を正午までに必要としている。印刷ポータル経由のカラーは1営業日かかるので、マークに連絡して5階の高速カラープリンターの使用許可を得る。
